research.searchCoverage: Official Clerk Backend API authentication, instance, users list/count/get docs, company identity, and dated SDK CVE/incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical non-China SDK issues are recorded; no current unresolved platform breach is asserted.

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.usefulness: Clerk read operations provide instance health and user inventory for integration workflows.
exception.incident: Historical Clerk JavaScript SDK issues include January 2024 CVE-2024-22206 IDOR in auth helpers and March 2026 CVE-2026-34076 SSRF in opt-in clerkFrontendApiProxy that could leak Clerk-Secret-Key.
exception.remediation: Clerk published patched SDK versions (including @clerk/backend 3.2.3 for CVE-2026-34076), disclosed the issues, and recommended key rotation when the opt-in proxy was used. Vendor reports no evidence of proxy exploitation.
exception.residualRisk: Customers on unpatched SDK versions that enabled frontendApiProxy should upgrade and rotate secret keys. Live authentication and current security posture are unverified.

research.searchCoverage: Official Clerk Backend API authentication, instance, users list/count/get docs, San Francisco Clerk, Inc. identity, and dated SDK CVE/incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical non-China SDK issues are recorded; no current unresolved platform breach is asserted.

incidents.affectedData: Improper access control (IDOR) in auth() / getAuth(); Clerk reports no evidence of exploitation.
incidents.remediation: CVE-2024-22206 published and patched in the Clerk SDKs.
incidents.residualRisk: Applications that did not upgrade remain exposed to the historical SDK defect.

incidents.affectedProduct: opt-in clerkFrontendApiProxy in @clerk/backend and related packages
incidents.affectedData: Potential Clerk-Secret-Key leakage via SSRF to an attacker-controlled host when the opt-in proxy was enabled.
incidents.remediation: Patched in @clerk/backend 3.2.3, @clerk/express 2.0.7, @clerk/fastify 3.1.5, @clerk/hono 0.1.5. Clerk recommended rotating secret keys if the proxy was used; vendor logs showed no evidence of proxy use on impacted versions.
incidents.residualRisk: Unpatched applications that enabled frontendApiProxy should upgrade and rotate keys.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck uses official GET /v1/instance from the native validator; instance fetch is not a named upstream action, so the mapping reuses list_users.

Native category is dev-tools rather than security: Clerk is a developer identity/auth API, but Rust CATEGORIES has no security bucket; admitted ops are instance and user reads, not a generic security scanner.

Returns raw Clerk JSON under data (array or object). Scalar limit/offset/order_by/query are caller-controlled; repeated array filters from the upstream action are omitted because the native query template cannot express multi-value appends without unused inputs.
Exposes GET /users/count with an optional query string. Repeated array filters from the upstream action are omitted.
user_id is URL-encoded in the path. Upstream wraps the payload as {user}; the native operation returns raw Clerk JSON under data.
